gatoh.graphs.GroupGraph.node_relationships_count

GroupGraph.node_relationships_count(node_index: int) → int[source]

Report the number of ingoing and outgoing relationships that a specific node is involved in.

Parameters:

node_index (int) – The index of the node that is being inspected.

Raises:

IndexError – If the input node index is out of bounds.

Returns:

The total number of relationships involving the input node.

Return type:

int
